tools.name: intent_publish_intent
tools.description: Use this when the user asks AutoIsto to keep watching Czech car listings for them over time (e.g. "let me know until March about an estate car under 300 000 CZK, not diesel"). This does NOT start watching by itself and takes no e-mail address or other personal data: it returns a consentUrl on www.autoisto.cz that the user must open themselves, enter their own e-mail there and confirm by clicking the link AutoIsto e-mails them. Never ask the user for their e-mail in the conversation and never open the link for them. An unconfirmed draft is deleted after 24 hours. Matching cars are e-mailed to the user and can also be read with intent_list_matches using the returned intentCode — keep it in the conversation. hiddenLimitCzk is optional: the most the user would pay, stored encrypted and never shown to sellers or returned by any tool; pass it only if the user said it. Matches come from listings AutoIsto CZ aggregates from the Czech market (its own sellers' listings and public listings from Czech car portals), so they cover only cars listed on AutoIsto CZ (Czech Republic, CZK) and may be incomplete.

statement.description: What the car MUST be, as one short Czech (or Slovak) phrase with prices in CZK, e.g. "kombi do 300000 Kč ne diesel".

niceToHave.description: Wishes that are not required (never filters), e.g. "tažné, automat".

buyBy.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) by which the user wants to buy; watching stops after it.

hiddenLimitCzk.description: Optional private maximum price in CZK; encrypted on receipt and never returned by any tool.

tools.name: intent_get_intent
tools.description: Use this to check whether an intent created with intent_publish_intent is already confirmed by the user and active, waiting, expired or withdrawn. Requires the intentCode; returns the statement and dates only — never the user's e-mail, the hidden limit or any other personal data.

tools.name: intent_list_matches
tools.description: Use this when the user asks what AutoIsto has found for an intent created with intent_publish_intent. These are the same cars AutoIsto e-mails to the user; this server cannot send messages into the conversation by itself. Requires the intentCode; optional since (ISO time) returns only newer matches. Returns at most 20 newest matches with the price in CZK and AutoIsto price verdict at the time of the match and a link. Before the user confirms the intent there are no matches. Matches come from listings AutoIsto CZ aggregates from the market, so they cover only cars listed on AutoIsto CZ and may be incomplete; a car may already be sold.

since.description: Only matches found after this ISO time.

tools.name: intent_withdraw_intent
tools.description: Use this when the user wants AutoIsto to stop watching for an intent created with intent_publish_intent. Takes effect immediately; nothing more is e-mailed for it. Requires the intentCode.

tools.name: intent_search_offers
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to find a used car for sale in the Czech Republic now. Pass what they are looking for as one short phrase (Czech or Slovak works best), e.g. "toyota rav4 hybrid do 600000 Kč". Returns up to 20 cars from AutoIsto CZ's offer in its own order, each with a link to the car on www.autoisto.cz, plus what was understood, which words were not applied and what had to be relaxed. When suggestIntent is true (nothing or little found, or part of the phrase was dropped), offer the user intent_publish_intent with the same statement so AutoIsto CZ keeps watching. Results come from listings AutoIsto CZ aggregates from the Czech market and may be incomplete; no seller contact is returned.

statement.description: What the user is looking for, e.g. "suv automat do 500000 Kč".

limit.description: At most this many cars (default 10; AutoIsto CZ returns at most 10).
